newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Yahoo! restates Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Yahoo! restates Q2 results.

text.p: Revised Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations
Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

Note - Yahoo! and Visa entered into agreements in which the Visa Group releases certain obligations, claims and its 45% ownership of a limited liability company (Yahoo! Marketplace L.L.C.) previously founded by Yahoo! and Visa International.

In connection with the agreement, Yahoo! has issued 466,321 shares of Yahoo! common stock to the Visa Group. As required for financial reporting purposes, Yahoo! recorded a one-time, non-cash, pre-tax charge of $21,245,000 in its second quarter ended June 30, 1997 and updated its previously released second quarter results to reflect the non-cash charge.

As previously reported, revenues for the second quarter ended June 30, 1997 totaled $13,520,000 compared to revenues of $3,274,000 for the second quarter of 1996. Including the charge, the net loss for the second quarter was $20,544,000 or $0.74 per share, compared to a net loss of $1,366,000 or $0.05 per share for the second quarter of 1996. Excluding this one-time non-cash charge, the net income for the second quarter was $610,000 or $0.02 per share, as previously reported on July 9, 1997.
